description_en: Queries the configuration, status, and authorization statistics of a specified cloud browser group
description_zh: 查询指定云浏览器组的配置、状态和授权统计
name: GetBrowserInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en: The cloud browser group ID. This parameter is required. Specify the ID of a browser group that is created under the current account
parameters.help_zh: 云浏览器组标识，必填。请填写当前账号下已创建的浏览器组标识
parameters.name: browser_instance_group_id

BrowserInstanceGroupModel.description_en: The details of the browser group

AuthNotificationEnabled.description_en: Indicates whether authorization and deauthorization notification emails are enabled. `true` indicates that the feature is enabled. `false` indicates that the feature is disabled
AuthNotificationEnabled.description_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件。`true` 表示启用，`false` 表示关闭
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_en: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件
AuthNotificationEnabled.title_zh: 是否启用授权及解除授权通知邮件

AuthorizedUserInfo.description_en: The statistics of authorized users for the browser group
AuthorizedUserInfo.description_zh: 浏览器组的授权用户统计

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorized users

TotalUserGroupCount.description_en: The total number of authorized user groups

BizRegionId.description_en: The business region where the browser group resides
BizRegionId.description_zh: 浏览器组所在的业务地域

Bookmarks.description_en: The list of browser bookmarks. A maximum of 20 entries are returned. To query the complete bookmark list, call `ListBrowserBookmarks`
Bookmarks.description_zh: 浏览器书签列表。详情最多返回前 20 条；查询完整书签列表请调用 `ListBrowserBookmarks`

BookmarkFolder.description_en: The folder in which the bookmark resides

BrowserParam.description_en: The browser startup parameters. For example, `--incognito` specifies the incognito window mode
BrowserParam.description_zh: 浏览器启动参数，例如 `--incognito` 表示隐身窗口

CookiesSync.description_en: The cookie synchronization configuration. The string `true` indicates that synchronization is enabled. The string `false` indicates that synchronization is disabled
CookiesSync.description_zh: Cookie 同步配置。字符串 `true` 表示开启，`false` 表示关闭

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL that opens when the browser starts
Homepage.description_zh: 浏览器启动时打开的首页地址

BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The ID of the browser group set to which the browser group belongs
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 所属浏览器组集合的标识
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_en: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。
BrowserInstanceGroupSetId.title_zh: 浏览器交付组集合 ID。

ChargeType.description_en: The billing type. In MAU scenarios, `PostPaid` is returned, which indicates the pay-as-you-go billing method
ChargeType.description_zh: 付费类型。MAU 场景返回 `PostPaid`，表示后付费

DefaultAccessUrl.description_en: The default access URL of the browser group. Use the URL returned by the API to access the browser group. Replace the resource ID in the example with your actual value
DefaultAccessUrl.description_zh: 浏览器组的默认访问地址。请使用接口实际返回的地址访问；示例中的资源标识需要替换

Duration.description_en: The plan duration information. In MAU scenarios, plan duration does not apply, and an empty object may be returned
Duration.description_zh: 套餐时长信息。MAU 场景不涉及套餐时长，可返回空对象

CurrentPayStage.description_en: The current payment stage of the plan. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
CurrentPayStage.description_zh: 套餐当前支付阶段。MAU 场景不涉及

PeriodEndTime.description_en: The end time of the plan period. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios and is not returned
PeriodEndTime.description_zh: 套餐周期结束时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

PeriodStartTime.description_en: The start time of the plan period. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios and is not returned
PeriodStartTime.description_zh: 套餐周期开始时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

TotalDuration.description_en: The total duration of the plan, in seconds. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
TotalDuration.description_zh: 套餐总时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

UsedDuration.description_en: The used duration of the plan, in seconds. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
UsedDuration.description_zh: 套餐已使用时长，单位为秒。MAU 场景不涉及

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the browser group. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios and is not returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 浏览器组过期时间。MAU 场景不涉及，不返回该字段

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the browser group. The value is an RFC 3339 time string in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX` format, which includes milliseconds and a time zone offset. The `+00:00` in the example indicates the UTC time zone
GmtCreate.description_zh: 浏览器组创建时间。采用 RFC 3339 时间字符串，格式为 `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX`，包含毫秒和时区偏移。示例中的 `+00:00` 表示 UTC 零时区

Homepage.description_en: The homepage URL of the browser group

ImageId.description_en: The image ID used by the browser group
ImageId.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的镜像标识

InstanceType.description_en: The instance type used by the browser group
InstanceType.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的实例规格

MaxAmount.description_en: The maximum number of instances configured for the MAU scenario
MaxAmount.description_zh: MAU 场景配置的最大实例数

Network.description_en: The office network and website access restriction configuration
Network.description_zh: 办公网络及网站访问限制配置

AccessRestriction.description_en:
The website access restriction mode.

`ALLOW_ALL`: All domain names are allowed.
`ALLOW_LIST`: Only websites in the allowlist are allowed.

The returned value reflects the current configuration of the browser group
AccessRestriction.description_zh:
网站访问限制模式。

`ALLOW_ALL`：允许所有域名。
`ALLOW_LIST`：仅允许名单内的网站。

返回值反映该浏览器组现有配置

OfficeSiteId.description_en: The office network ID to which the browser group belongs
OfficeSiteId.description_zh: 浏览器组所属的办公网络标识

RestrictedURLs.description_en: The website access restriction list. A maximum of 20 entries are returned. To query the complete list, call `ListBrowserRestrictedURLs`
RestrictedURLs.description_zh: 网站访问限制列表。详情最多返回前 20 条；查询完整列表请调用 `ListBrowserRestrictedURLs`

items.description_zh: 一条允许访问的网址配置

RestrictedURLId.description_en: The ID of the website access restriction entry
RestrictedURLId.description_zh: 网站访问限制条目标识

URL.description_en: The website URL in the access restriction entry
URL.description_zh: 访问限制条目中的网站地址

VSwitchIds.description_en: The list of vSwitch IDs used by the browser group. This is available for scenarios with custom network configurations
VSwitchIds.description_zh: 浏览器组使用的交换机标识列表，供已配置定制网络的场景查看

NodeInstanceType.description_en: The node specifications information. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
NodeInstanceType.description_zh: 节点规格信息。MAU 场景不涉及

Cpu.description_en: The CPU configuration of the node. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
Cpu.description_zh: 节点 CPU 配置。MAU 场景不涉及

Memory.description_en: The memory configuration of the node. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
Memory.description_zh: 节点内存配置。MAU 场景不涉及

NodePool.description_en: The list of node pool information. In MAU scenarios, this field does not apply and an empty list may be returned
NodePool.description_zh: 节点池信息列表。MAU 场景不涉及，可返回空列表

items.description_en: The node pool information. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
items.description_zh: 节点池信息。MAU 场景不涉及

NodeAmount.description_en: The total number of nodes. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
NodeAmount.description_zh: 节点总数。MAU 场景不涉及

NodeUsed.description_en: The number of used nodes. This field does not apply to MAU scenarios
NodeUsed.description_zh: 已使用节点数。MAU 场景不涉及

OsType.description_en: The operating system type of the browser group. The current MAU product scenario uses Windows
OsType.description_zh: 浏览器组的操作系统类型。当前 MAU 产品场景使用 Windows

Policy.description_en: The policy configuration returned for the browser group. The policy fields are used to view existing settings and do not indicate that all corresponding creation parameters are configurable
Policy.description_zh: 浏览器组返回的策略配置。策略字段用于查看现有设置，不代表对应创建参数均可配置

AppContentProtection.description_en:
The screenshot protection switch.

`on`: Screenshot protection is enabled.
`off`: Screenshot protection is disabled
AppContentProtection.description_zh:
防截屏开关。

`on`：开启防截屏。
`off`：关闭防截屏

AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_en: The client access IP address whitelist rules
AuthorizeAccessPolicyRules.description_zh: 客户端访问 IP 白名单规则

items.description_en: A client source IP access rule
items.description_zh: 一条客户端来源 IP 访问规则

CidrIp.description_en: The client source CIDR block that is allowed to access the browser group
CidrIp.description_zh: 允许访问的客户端来源网段

Description.description_en: The description of the client access rule
Description.description_zh: 客户端访问规则的说明

Policy.description_en:
The action of the client access rule.

`allow`: Access is allowed.
`deny`: Access is denied
Policy.description_zh:
客户端访问规则的动作。

`allow`：允许访问。
`deny`：拒绝访问

ClientTypes.description_en: The list of client access control configurations
ClientTypes.description_zh: 客户端访问控制配置列表

items.description_en: The access switch configuration for a client type
items.description_zh: 一种客户端的访问开关配置

ClientType.description_en:
The client type.

`windows`: Windows client.
`macos`: macOS client.
`html5`: Web client.
`linux`: Linux client.
`android`: Android client.
`ios`: iOS client.

This field reflects the existing access configuration and does not indicate that all client types are available for the current product
ClientType.description_zh:
客户端类型。

`windows`：Windows 客户端。
`macos`：macOS 客户端。
`html5`：Web 客户端。
`linux`：Linux 客户端。
`android`：Android 客户端。
`ios`：iOS 客户端。

本字段反映已有访问配置，不代表当前产品开放所有客户端

Status.description_en:
The access policy switch for the client type.

`on`: Access from this client type is allowed.
`off`: Access from this client type is denied
Status.description_zh:
该客户端类型的访问策略开关。

`on`：允许该类客户端访问。
`off`：禁止该类客户端访问

ClipboardPolicy.description_en: The clipboard transfer direction, content type, and size limit settings. read indicates transfer from the local PC to the cloud browser. write indicates transfer from the cloud browser to the local PC
ClipboardPolicy.description_zh: 设置剪贴板传输方向、内容类型和大小限制。read 表示本地 PC 到云浏览器，write 表示云浏览器到本地 PC

Clipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is case-insensitive.

`off`: Bidirectional transfer is denied.
`read`: Copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser is allowed.
`write`: Copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC is allowed.
`readwrite`: Bidirectional transfer is allowed
Clipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`off`：双向禁止。
`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

ClipboardReadLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for inbound transfer (from the local PC to the cloud browser)
ClipboardReadLimit.description_zh: 入云（本地 PC 到云浏览器）剪贴板大小限制

ClipboardScope.description_en:
The clipboard control granularity.

`global`: Unified control.
`grained`: Separate control by text, rich text, and file
ClipboardScope.description_zh:
剪贴板控制粒度。

`global`：统一控制。
`grained`：按文本、富文本和文件分别控制

ClipboardSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
ClipboardSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节

ClipboardWriteLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for outbound transfer (from the cloud browser to the local PC)
ClipboardWriteLimit.description_zh: 出云（云浏览器到本地 PC）剪贴板大小限制

FileClipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is case-insensitive.

`off`: Bidirectional transfer is denied.
`read`: Copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser is allowed.
`write`: Copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC is allowed.
`readwrite`: Bidirectional transfer is allowed
FileClipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`off`：双向禁止。
`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

RichTextClipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is case-insensitive.

`off`: Bidirectional transfer is denied.
`read`: Copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser is allowed.
`write`: Copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC is allowed.
`readwrite`: Bidirectional transfer is allowed
RichTextClipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`off`：双向禁止。
`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

RichTextClipboardLimit.description_en: The rich text clipboard size limit
RichTextClipboardLimit.description_zh: 富文本剪贴板大小限制

RichTextClipboardReadLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for inbound transfer (from the local PC to the cloud browser)
RichTextClipboardReadLimit.description_zh: 入云（本地 PC 到云浏览器）剪贴板大小限制
RichTextClipboardReadLimit.title_en: 剪切板富文本出云大小
RichTextClipboardReadLimit.title_zh: 剪切板富文本出云大小

RichTextClipboardReadSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
RichTextClipboardReadSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节
RichTextClipboardReadSizeUnit.title_en: 剪切板富文本出云单位
RichTextClipboardReadSizeUnit.title_zh: 剪切板富文本出云单位

RichTextClipboardSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
RichTextClipboardSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节

RichTextClipboardWriteLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for outbound transfer (from the cloud browser to the local PC)
RichTextClipboardWriteLimit.description_zh: 出云（云浏览器到本地 PC）剪贴板大小限制
RichTextClipboardWriteLimit.title_en: 剪切板富文本入云大小
RichTextClipboardWriteLimit.title_zh: 剪切板富文本入云大小

RichTextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
RichTextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节
RichTextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.title_en: 剪切板富文本入云单位
RichTextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.title_zh: 剪切板富文本入云单位

TextClipboard.description_en:
The clipboard transfer direction. The value is case-insensitive.

`off`: Bidirectional transfer is denied.
`read`: Copy and paste from the local PC to the cloud browser is allowed.
`write`: Copy and paste from the cloud browser to the local PC is allowed.
`readwrite`: Bidirectional transfer is allowed
TextClipboard.description_zh:
剪贴板传输方向，取值不区分大小写。

`read`：允许本地 PC 向云浏览器复制粘贴。
`write`：允许云浏览器向本地 PC 复制粘贴。
`readwrite`：双向允许

TextClipboardReadLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for inbound transfer (from the local PC to the cloud browser)
TextClipboardReadLimit.description_zh: 入云（本地 PC 到云浏览器）剪贴板大小限制

TextClipboardReadSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
TextClipboardReadSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节

TextClipboardWriteLimit.description_en: The clipboard size limit for outbound transfer (from the cloud browser to the local PC)
TextClipboardWriteLimit.description_zh: 出云（云浏览器到本地 PC）剪贴板大小限制

TextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.description_en:
The unit of the clipboard size.

`B`: bytes.
`KB`: 1024 bytes
TextClipboardWriteSizeUnit.description_zh:
剪贴板大小单位。

`B`：字节。
`KB`：1024 字节

DisconnectKeepSession.description_en:
The data retention policy for sessions after disconnection.

`customTime`: The session is retained for the duration specified by `DisconnectKeepSessionTime`.
`persistent`: The session is not subject to automatic release based on disconnection duration.

Note: The `persistent` option is still subject to authorization and other release policies
DisconnectKeepSession.description_zh:
断开连接后的会话保留策略。

`customTime`：按 `DisconnectKeepSessionTime` 指定的时长保留。
`persistent`：不按断连时长自动释放。

注意： `persistent` 仍受授权和其他释放策略影响

DisconnectKeepSessionTime.description_en: The session retention duration after disconnection. Unit: seconds. This value is for viewing the configuration only and does not indicate that this parameter can be set through the create operation
DisconnectKeepSessionTime.description_zh: 当前返回的断连会话保留时长，单位为秒。仅用于查看配置，不表示创建接口支持设置该参数

FileManager.description_en:
The floating ball file manager switch.

`on`: Enabled.
`off`: Disabled
FileManager.description_zh:
悬浮球文件管理器开关。

`on`：开启。
`off`：关闭
FileManager.title_en: 悬浮球文件管理器开关
FileManager.title_zh: 悬浮球文件管理器开关

Html5FileTransfer.description_en:
The file transfer policy for the web client.

`off`: Transfer is denied.
`upload`: Only upload is allowed.
`download`: Only download is allowed.
`full`: Both upload and download are allowed.

Configure this parameter together with the clipboard policy
Html5FileTransfer.description_zh:
网页端文件传输策略。

`off`：禁止传输。
`upload`：仅允许上传。
`download`：仅允许下载。
`full`：允许上传和下载。

请与剪贴板策略配合配置

NoOperationDisconnect.description_en:
The switch for automatic disconnection upon no operation. The value is case-insensitive.

`on`: Enabled.
`off`: Disabled.

When enabled, use `NoOperationDisconnectTime` to set the wait duration
NoOperationDisconnect.description_zh:
无操作自动断连开关，取值不区分大小写。

`on`：开启。
`off`：关闭。

开启时，通过 `NoOperationDisconnectTime` 设置等待时长

NoOperationDisconnectTime.description_en: The wait duration before disconnection is triggered after no operation, in seconds. Whether this feature is enabled is indicated by `NoOperationDisconnect`
NoOperationDisconnectTime.description_zh: 无操作后触发断连的等待时长，单位为秒；是否启用由 `NoOperationDisconnect` 表示

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the policy associated with the browser instance group
PolicyId.description_zh: 浏览器组关联的策略标识

PolicyVersion.description_en:
The policy version.

`DEFAULT`: Legacy policy.
`CENTER`: Centralized policy
PolicyVersion.description_zh:
策略版本。

`DEFAULT`：旧策略。
`CENTER`：中心化策略

VideoPolicy.description_en: The video display policy for browser sessions
VideoPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的视频显示策略

FrameRate.description_en: The frame rate of browser sessions
FrameRate.description_zh: 浏览器会话的画面帧率

WatermarkPolicy.description_en: The watermark display configuration for browser sessions
WatermarkPolicy.description_zh: 浏览器会话的水印显示配置

WatermarkSwitch.description_en:
The watermark switch. The value is case-insensitive.

`ON`: Watermark enabled.
`OFF`: Watermark disabled.

When disabled, the watermark content type list is not used
WatermarkSwitch.description_zh:
水印开关，取值不区分大小写。

`ON`：开启水印。
`OFF`：关闭水印。

关闭时不使用水印内容类型列表

WatermarkTypes.description_en:
The list of watermark content types.

`EndUserId`: User ID.
`InstanceGroupId`: Delivery group ID.
`ClientTime`: Current time on the client.

Use watermark types supported by the browser and client
WatermarkTypes.description_zh:
水印内容类型列表。

`EndUserId`：用户标识。
`InstanceGroupId`：交付组标识。
`ClientTime`：客户端当前时间。

请使用浏览器及客户端支持的水印类型

items.description_en: The watermark content type. EndUserId indicates the user ID, InstanceGroupId indicates the delivery group ID, and ClientTime indicates the current time on the client
items.description_zh: 水印内容类型。EndUserId 表示用户标识，InstanceGroupId 表示交付组标识，ClientTime 表示客户端当前时间

Status.description_en:
The status of the browser instance group.

`DEPLOYING`: Being deployed.
`PUBLISHED`: Deployed.
`FAILED`: Deployment failed.
`EXPIRED`: Expired.
`CEASED`: Suspended due to overdue payment.
`MAINTAINING`: Being updated.
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`: Update failed.
`DELETING`: Being deleted.
`UNAVAILABLE`: Unavailable
Status.description_zh:
浏览器组状态。

`DEPLOYING`：发布中。
`PUBLISHED`：发布成功。
`FAILED`：发布失败。
`EXPIRED`：已过期。
`CEASED`：欠费停服。
`MAINTAINING`：更新中。
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`：更新失败。
`DELETING`：删除中。
`UNAVAILABLE`：不可用

SubPayType.description_en: The sub-billing type. In MAU scenarios, the actual returned value is `mau`, which indicates billing by monthly active users
SubPayType.description_zh: 付费子类型。MAU 场景实际返回 `mau`，表示按月活跃用户计费

SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_en: Indicates whether mixed authorization of users and user groups is supported. `true` indicates supported, and `false` indicates not supported. Evaluate this value based on the current authorization mode
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.description_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。`true` 表示支持，`false` 表示不支持；应结合当前授权模式判断
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_en: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。
SupportUserGroupMixedAuth.title_zh: 是否支持用户和用户组混合授权。

Tier.description_en:
The version of the browser.

`Basic`: Basic Edition.
`Pro`: Premium Edition.

In MAU scenarios, the value is `Pro`
Tier.description_zh:
浏览器版本。

`Basic`：基础版。
`Pro`：高级版。

MAU 场景为 `Pro`
